notes: Technical report on DeepSeek Sparse Attention, RL post-training, and agentic synthesis. No safety, alignment, honesty, refusal, jailbreak, bias, or dangerous-capability evaluation section or tables. All evalResults left empty per pilot safety-only rule. Skipped capability benchmarks (MMLU-Pro, GPQA, HLE, LiveCodeBench, Codeforces, AIME/HMMT/IMOAnswerBench, Terminal Bench, SWE-Verified/Multilingual, BrowseComp/Zh, tau2-bench, MCP-Universe/Mark, Tool-Decathlon, ChatbotArena Elo, AA-LCR, Fiction.liveBench, IMO/IOI/ICPC/CMO). DeepSeek-V3.2-Speciale and thinking/non-thinking modes treated as variants of deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V3.2 (Speciale is a seed checkpoint). DeepSeek-V3.2-Exp discussed for architecture parity but not listed in covers (prior release, not the report's introduced model). No parameter counts or license stated in the text. Reviewer: removed tester ChatbotArena (a public leaderboard, not a safety tester).
